title: Chemoproteomics reveals Ailanthone directly binds to PKM2 to inhibit the progression of Hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: Lin, Cheng; Wan, Yue; Huo, Qiang; Liu, Dachuan; Liu, Xinhua; Liu, Hao; Zhang, Yixuan; Cheng, Xiu
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过化学蛋白质组学发现Ailanthone直接结合PKM2蛋白抑制肝癌，虽用分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) is a widely recognized aggressive tumor, owing primarily to its high recurrence and metastasis risk. On the other hand, Ailanthone (AIL), a natural plant derivative, has demonstrated diverse pharmacological properties and a capacity to induce cell death among other mechanisms. Consequently, it could be employed to suppress HCC proliferation. Nonetheless, AIL's precise targets and mechanisms of action in inhibiting HCC cell growth remain unclear, forming the basis of this study. PURPOSE: To investigate the role and molecular mechanisms of AIL in inducing SMMC-7721 cell apoptosis and identify its key action targets. METHODS: First, the potential pathways and targets of AIL-induced cell death were identified via transcriptomics sequencing analyses. The impact of AIL on HCC cell growth was then evaluated both in vivo and in vitro, with the underlying mechanisms validated further. Finally, molecular docking, Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulation techniques, and Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) experiments were employed to elucidate AIL's binding target. RESULTS: Our findings revealed that AIL could inhibit Pyruvate Kinase M2 (PKM2) expression, thus suppressing the aerobic glycolysis level of HCC cells. Mechanistically, AIL induced SMMC-7721 cell apoptosis via the PKM2/HSP90/HIF-1alpha signaling pathway. Furthermore, molecular docking, MD simulation, and SPR experiments confirmed AIL's direct binding to PKM2. Specifically, AIL formed hydrogen bonds with PKM2 residues Lys311B, Leu353B, and Asp354A, accompanied by hydrophobic interactions with Phe26A/B and Leu353B. CONCLUSION: By binding directly to PKM2, AIL exerts anti-tumor effects in SMMC-7721 cells, with glycolysis inhibition via PKM2/HSP90/HIF-1alpha signaling axis suppression as the potential mechanism, which could be leveraged in HCC treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝细胞癌（Hepatocellular Carcinoma, HCC）是一种公认的侵袭性肿瘤，主要因其高复发和转移风险。另一方面，臭椿酮（Ailanthone, AIL）作为一种天然植物衍生物，已显示出多种药理特性，并具有诱导细胞死亡等机制。因此，它可用于抑制HCC增殖。然而，AIL在抑制HCC细胞生长中的精确靶点和作用机制仍不清楚，这构成了本研究的基础。目的：探讨AIL在诱导SMMC-7721细胞凋亡中的作用及分子机制，并识别其关键作用靶点。方法：首先，通过转录组学测序分析鉴定AIL诱导细胞死亡的潜在途径和靶点。随后，在体内和体外评估AIL对HCC细胞生长的影响，并进一步验证其潜在机制。最后，采用分子对接、分子动力学（Molecular Dynamics, MD）模拟技术和表面等离子体共振（Surface Plasmon Resonance, SPR）实验来阐明AIL的结合靶点。结果：我们的研究结果表明，AIL可抑制丙酮酸激酶M2（Pyruvate Kinase M2, PKM2）表达，从而抑制HCC细胞的有氧糖酵解水平。机制上，AIL通过PKM2/HSP90/HIF-1α信号通路诱导SMMC-7721细胞凋亡。此外，分子对接、MD模拟和SPR实验证实了AIL与PKM2的直接结合。具体而言，AIL与PKM2残基Lys311B、Leu353B和Asp354A形成氢键，并与Phe26A/B和Leu353B发生疏水相互作用。结论：通过直接结合PKM2，AIL在SMMC-7721细胞中发挥抗肿瘤作用，其潜在机制是通过抑制PKM2/HSP90/HIF-1α信号轴来抑制糖酵解，这可用于HCC治疗。
